label: fortune_telling
quote: soon I will be revealed to be an incompetent and inept fool
rationale: Predicts a specific negative future outcome with no supporting evidence — a textbook fortune-telling pattern.

label: labeling
rationale: Attaches a global identity label ("fool") to the self based on a single anticipated event rather than describing a behavior.

label: emotional_reasoning
quote: I feel like perhaps I am wasting my time
rationale: Treats a transient feeling (boredom, fatigue) as evidence about an objective question (whether the time is well spent).

label: magnification_minimization
rationale: Magnifies methodological uncertainty into total wrongness while minimizing the value of work already done.
